layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. Use p-8 to p-16 for containers. Avoid cramped layouts.
layouts.bento_grid: Use asymmetrical 'Tetris' grid for project lab and stack sections to avoid boring symmetry.
layouts.borders: 1px solid borders with 10-20% opacity. Avoid heavy shadows; use crisp 'Inner Glow' highlights.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Retro-Futurism / Terminal look. Deep black backgrounds, crisp borders. Occasional glassmorphism with high backdrop-blur and 1px border for floating nav/modals.
visual_enhancers.motion: Framer Motion for scroll reveals, staggered list entries, and modal scaling. Use `lenis` for smooth scrolling.
visual_enhancers.3d: React Three Fiber for the hero section (subtle floating particles, soft lighting, controlled camera, depth). Ensure transparent background.
visual_enhancers.cursor: Custom glowing dot cursor using framer-motion that reacts to interactive elements.
visual_enhancers.marquee: Slow editorial marquee for key skills or 'BUILDING / LEARNING' text.

motion.boot_sequence: On load, show a full-screen terminal typing: ROSHANI.KAMBLE / DEVELOPER SYSTEM / INITIALIZING / SYSTEM READY. Then fade out. Allow 'SKIP' button.
motion.hero_reveal: Kinetic masked line-by-line hero typography reveal after boot.
motion.scroll_reveals: Fade up and staggered reveals for sections using framer-motion.
motion.accessibility: Always respect `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` by disabling complex 3D and heavy framer-motion transitions.

audio.strategy: Subtle interface sounds. OFF by default.
audio.toggle: Clear sound/mute toggle in global navigation/connect section.
audio.events: Boot sequence hum, project window open (soft click), project window close (soft woosh).

accessibility.focus_states: Use highly visible outline (e.g. ring-2 ring-accent_primary) for keyboard navigation.
accessibility.aria: Add aria-labels to all buttons, links, and project modals.
accessibility.motion: Use a global toggle or CSS standard @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) to turn off canvas and heavy framer-motion animations.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure `data-testid` attributes are applied across ALL actionable and informational components for E2E testing.
Implement a realistic boot sequence using terminal-styled output. Do not make it too slow, add a skip mechanism.
Do not use `Inter` or standard sans fonts for headings. Stick to Unbounded or similar tech/display fonts for headings.
Keep 3D canvas lightweight. Prefer abstract geometric particle systems that do not choke lower-end devices.
On mobile, conditionally hide the 3D canvas or replace it with a simple CSS gradient/pattern to save battery and performance.
Audio should be strictly OFF initially, represented by a speaker-off icon in the nav.
No fully transparent backgrounds in navigation. Use `backdrop-blur-md` with `bg-surface/80`.
Do NOT center align block text or paragraphs; use left alignment for better readability and a terminal vibe.
Project modals should resemble window frames from an advanced OS (title bar, X close button).
Avoid the generic 'AI slop' aesthetic. Ensure crisp 1px borders, solid charcoal components, electric cyan highlights, and strong typographic hierarchy.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use `sonner` for toasts. Sonner component are located in `/app/src/components/ui/sonner.js`
You have .js files not .tsx files, so share the guideline for .js files not for .tsx files
